title: Those Who Speak The Unspoken, Drink In
summary: Gratitude is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Gauree, First Mehla:; those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar
lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Gauree, First Mehla:; those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: Gauree, First Mehla:; those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar
evidence.turn: Gratitude steadies when o Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away.
evidence.practicalImplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
